stem: A 43 yr old man is reviewed in the clinic following a cardiac operation. A chest X- ray is performed and a circular radio-opaque structure is noted in the medial aspect of the 4th intercostal space on the left. Which of the following procedures is the patient most likely to have undergone?

options.A: Aortic valve replacement with metallic valve
options.B: Tricuspid valve replacement with metallic valve
options.C: Tricuspid valve replacement with porcine valve
options.D: Pulmonary valve replacement with porcine valve
options.E: Mitral valve replacement with metallic valve

explanation: On chest X-ray, a mechanical mitral valve projects at about the left 4th intercostal space medially, lower and more lateral than an aortic prosthesis; porcine valves are largely radiolucent apart from their ring or stent.
key_note: Not marked in the source paper; answer by reviewer. Compiled key agrees.
